description: Calculate LTL shipment density (lbs/ft³), recommended NMFC Freight Class (Class 50 to Class 500, including Class 85 for 12–13.5 lbs/ft³ under the density-first NMFC framework), linear feet, 53-foot dry van trailer cube and weight utilization, and whether the load fits Standard LTL, Volume LTL / Partial, or Full Truckload (53' FTL). Use this before estimate_ltl_rate whenever the user gives pallet or crate dimensions and weight instead of a freight class. Pure arithmetic; does not count toward the estimate allowance.

height_in.description: Height of one pallet, crate, or piece in inches (including pallet height, e.g. 48).

length_in.description: Length of one pallet, crate, or piece in inches (standard pallet = 48).

quantity.description: Number of identical pallets or pieces. Null defaults to 1.

stackable.description: Whether pallets can be double-stacked (applies when height <= 54 inches). Null defaults to false.

weight_per_unit.description: Weight of one pallet, crate, or piece.

weight_unit.description: Weight unit: 'lbs' or 'kg'. Null defaults to 'lbs'.

width_in.description: Width of one pallet, crate, or piece in inches (standard pallet = 40).

name: calculate_freight_class
title: Calculate NMFC freight class, density & 53' trailer cube
